**Cephalexin does not have a direct, dangerous interaction with alcohol, nor does alcohol stop the antibiotic from working** . However, ` [Highlight start] drinking alcohol while taking cephalexin is generally discouraged because it can worsen side effects and slow your recovery [Highlight end] ` . As noted by the [NHS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1yDzrKSNXkIFFZXYEUMbDUQul68Vc-DkA6tCDpgBUjzO3hzo8ikmwq23s_LevhjvAxyuyNyLmVim6bmmhtr2NqzzETE8GiiJEpcoZxm8MAW41d5Zw_5oEQ5z4sgO3CJFGTKdkFo-6EujCWuPIqjL0Rp1kd6Mi_2SXjHCO3lZMA) , drinking alcohol is permitted with cefalexin, though clinicians often recommend avoiding it until you feel better.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1yDzrKSNXkIFFZXYEUMbDUQul68Vc-DkA6tCDpgBUjzO3hzo8ikmwq23s_LevhjvAxyuyNyLmVim6bmmhtr2NqzzETE8GiiJEpcoZxm8MAW41d5Zw_5oEQ5z4sgO3CJFGTKdkFo-6EujCWuPIqjL0Rp1kd6Mi_2SXjHCO3lZMA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX-9BLI5jvH07WjkSnJ8iAUBPjjGmguHZDUOME8UdZvqts4ESwx17CfBdV-jgThHYyr092oNxfweEPZAowSZsDnW4GA3fDQ5QNeuzK37KdaocNBnP3IicT9tiJYh4Ub_TLyjkZNi9yrrZ9teqxKnzwzqZzQbSX_W4Tdw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12fYeZeTw6HNZIw8sDp0ZpbGc0HiNMbQKe_LOWqwgaRmLK3Irt237qUbjNnx3izTzqWx8ZYe5vNuYDt3Ehte9zD-q19uj9H3OFO42I6GI8VHeRP_GmK5yxtpEd9Pk5uzEjjqd2LUiA2-OE430Sj3ITVNogPHls6h6R-XuASeJUs9tJPP9hzypSBk4hAEAc5aXQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXxe-RBArS8zYemI2Nq2Cn6iXhFep1Q0NvZUlWZtOoHdwVKeITvm9NI0GTiZFkjZpCdYOjaAbTstrekFp8mcNcr1p-LyaG_UaAvBPdBnc6vJ3vPEJCW3rlVz7kxEIHybOscUO9FRSnP4iXJ9DGD3fb0s9s5Oaqgr49qhM)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlNvg-TvLZUu_r53y4LLumxnLka1HOZjN_LrKsRB_wl-F933JkP5ROtlBQqPNEqS1MVWvGb0RpNVBBaMQfEP_Xm5hWlqrV132d8YM65SaMzse7HD8qwG1VxTxor1dd7uzm_NvlQ)

### Why Doctors Often Recommend Avoiding Alcohol

- **Worsened side effects:** Both cephalexin and alcohol can cause nausea, stomach upset, vomiting, diarrhea, and dizziness. Combining them can make these symptoms stronger.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlNvg-TvLZUu_r53y4LLumxnLka1HOZjN_LrKsRB_wl-F933JkP5ROtlBQqPNEqS1MVWvGb0RpNVBBaMQfEP_Xm5hWlqrV132d8YM65SaMzse7HD8qwG1VxTxor1dd7uzm_NvlQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12fYeZeTw6HNZIw8sDp0ZpbGc0HiNMbQKe_LOWqwgaRmLK3Irt237qUbjNnx3izTzqWx8ZYe5vNuYDt3Ehte9zD-q19uj9H3OFO42I6GI8VHeRP_GmK5yxtpEd9Pk5uzEjjqd2LUiA2-OE430Sj3ITVNogPHls6h6R-XuASeJUs9tJPP9hzypSBk4hAEAc5aXQ)
- **Slower recovery:** Alcohol can disrupt sleep, cause dehydration, and temporarily weaken your immune response while your body is fighting an infection. For urinary tract infections (UTIs), alcohol may also irritate the bladder.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXa18r1eh5HUdzJCR1QZv6Bd2uomfqNOcKJRaPV8jtfHkcdW7EWeN2Ed9WjPzIYzn1PdUM2RyUnYjL1tY3khIK8ztbWHRsrC1weZOTbjIe0CgIU_tX2ShgnT1-jf8I-YbOi1Xbggoc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlNvg-TvLZUu_r53y4LLumxnLka1HOZjN_LrKsRB_wl-F933JkP5ROtlBQqPNEqS1MVWvGb0RpNVBBaMQfEP_Xm5hWlqrV132d8YM65SaMzse7HD8qwG1VxTxor1dd7uzm_NvlQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12fYeZeTw6HNZIw8sDp0ZpbGc0HiNMbQKe_LOWqwgaRmLK3Irt237qUbjNnx3izTzqWx8ZYe5vNuYDt3Ehte9zD-q19uj9H3OFO42I6GI8VHeRP_GmK5yxtpEd9Pk5uzEjjqd2LUiA2-OE430Sj3ITVNogPHls6h6R-XuASeJUs9tJPP9hzypSBk4hAEAc5aXQ)
- **Harder to track symptoms:** Hangovers or alcohol-related side effects can mimic or mask infection symptoms or medication reactions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX-9BLI5jvH07WjkSnJ8iAUBPjjGmguHZDUOME8UdZvqts4ESwx17CfBdV-jgThHYyr092oNxfweEPZAowSZsDnW4GA3fDQ5QNeuzK37KdaocNBnP3IicT9tiJYh4Ub_TLyjkZNi9yrrZ9teqxKnzwzqZzQbSX_W4Tdw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12fYeZeTw6HNZIw8sDp0ZpbGc0HiNMbQKe_LOWqwgaRmLK3Irt237qUbjNnx3izTzqWx8ZYe5vNuYDt3Ehte9zD-q19uj9H3OFO42I6GI8VHeRP_GmK5yxtpEd9Pk5uzEjjqd2LUiA2-OE430Sj3ITVNogPHls6h6R-XuASeJUs9tJPP9hzypSBk4hAEAc5aXQ)
- **Missed doses:** Drinking can make it easier to forget a scheduled dose of your antibiotic.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX-9BLI5jvH07WjkSnJ8iAUBPjjGmguHZDUOME8UdZvqts4ESwx17CfBdV-jgThHYyr092oNxfweEPZAowSZsDnW4GA3fDQ5QNeuzK37KdaocNBnP3IicT9tiJYh4Ub_TLyjkZNi9yrrZ9teqxKnzwzqZzQbSX_W4Tdw)

### Important Caveats

- **Disulfiram-like reactions:** Certain other cephalosporin antibiotics (such as cefotetan or cefoperazone) can cause a severe reaction—flushing, fast heartbeat, nausea, and low blood pressure—when mixed with alcohol. While cephalexin is not typically linked to this reaction, it belongs to the same antibiotic class.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12fYeZeTw6HNZIw8sDp0ZpbGc0HiNMbQKe_LOWqwgaRmLK3Irt237qUbjNnx3izTzqWx8ZYe5vNuYDt3Ehte9zD-q19uj9H3OFO42I6GI8VHeRP_GmK5yxtpEd9Pk5uzEjjqd2LUiA2-OE430Sj3ITVNogPHls6h6R-XuASeJUs9tJPP9hzypSBk4hAEAc5aXQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlNvg-TvLZUu_r53y4LLumxnLka1HOZjN_LrKsRB_wl-F933JkP5ROtlBQqPNEqS1MVWvGb0RpNVBBaMQfEP_Xm5hWlqrV132d8YM65SaMzse7HD8qwG1VxTxor1dd7uzm_NvlQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXMb3_Edf8pp-Yon0bU23NTZvOoyt4xZDyL1m2mg9Gq72ePKsYYk-hmbvMH2VAC3j6CY1itScPEa7k1t1zeyhPEP7D_r9AyWIICKYJDlntRCwGfZB74ZMXxFqApD3tmjX7uaftME4m0g)
- **Kidney function and other medications:** Your kidneys clear cephalexin from your body, and your overall health or other prescriptions may change how you tolerate alcohol. A breakdown of alcohol and antibiotic interactions is available in Fact versus Fiction: a Review of the Evidence behind Alcohol and Antibiotic Interactions , and further context on drinking patterns is covered by [Rehab 4 Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX-9BLI5jvH07WjkSnJ8iAUBPjjGmguHZDUOME8UdZvqts4ESwx17CfBdV-jgThHYyr092oNxfweEPZAowSZsDnW4GA3fDQ5QNeuzK37KdaocNBnP3IicT9tiJYh4Ub_TLyjkZNi9yrrZ9teqxKnzwzqZzQbSX_W4Tdw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlNvg-TvLZUu_r53y4LLumxnLka1HOZjN_LrKsRB_wl-F933JkP5ROtlBQqPNEqS1MVWvGb0RpNVBBaMQfEP_Xm5hWlqrV132d8YM65SaMzse7HD8qwG1VxTxor1dd7uzm_NvlQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12fYeZeTw6HNZIw8sDp0ZpbGc0HiNMbQKe_LOWqwgaRmLK3Irt237qUbjNnx3izTzqWx8ZYe5vNuYDt3Ehte9zD-q19uj9H3OFO42I6GI8VHeRP_GmK5yxtpEd9Pk5uzEjjqd2LUiA2-OE430Sj3ITVNogPHls6h6R-XuASeJUs9tJPP9hzypSBk4hAEAc5aXQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXrGCMuT9oDrBxM2vPlAIbB4rhwdzyy723C_n_KelfXj7aA_IMd0UL2EtGJVIB7Z3JLoVwxOTiGYTkmaqnS8xG9IGbw98eOlMB7Npz4CNyV3Ul_apMHaXuWqPr5A1aspYEKkMECEPWLQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX-9BLI5jvH07WjkSnJ8iAUBPjjGmguHZDUOME8UdZvqts4ESwx17CfBdV-jgThHYyr092oNxfweEPZAowSZsDnW4GA3fDQ5QNeuzK37KdaocNBnP3IicT9tiJYh4Ub_TLyjkZNi9yrrZ9teqxKnzwzqZzQbSX_W4Tdw)
